(ns itonami.quota (:export [account-left admit marker]))
;; Registered free pilot: 3 accepted attempts per account per UTC day, 100 per service.
(defn account-left [used :i64] :i64 (max 0 (- 3 used)))
(defn admit [account-used :i64 service-used :i64] :bool (if (< 0 (account-left account-used)) (< service-used 100) false))
(defn marker [] :i64 7)

(ns murakumo.budget (:export [output-cap can-generate marker]))
;; Murakumo gateway: cap requested output tokens to the context window left after the prompt.
(defn output-cap [requested :i64 window :i64 prompt :i64] :i64 (max (min requested (- window prompt)) 0))
(defn can-generate [requested :i64 window :i64 prompt :i64] :bool (< 0 (output-cap requested window prompt)))
(defn marker [] :i64 7)
